objects.description: ARTEX (Autonomous Red Team EXecution): open-source multi-agent, LLM-driven autonomous penetration-testing framework. Went from GitHub release to in-the-wild intrusions in under three months. CrowdStrike tied it to intrusions at South Korean financial institutions (2026-10-07); Microsoft linked it to Storm-0940 activity. SOCRadar confirmed 916 live ARTEX-family web consoles on U.S. hosting (snapshot 2026-11-11). Forks are renamed often, so name-based detection lags.
